definitions.explanation: Keeping food or other items at a cool temperature (above freezing) to preserve freshness.

examples.japanese: ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{冷蔵|れいぞう}{庫|こ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There is milk in the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{常温|じょうおん}→常温：14722_jouon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{放置|ほうち}しない→放置する：25382_houchisuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This medicine requires refrigerated storage, so please do not leave it at room temperature.

notes:
Compound of {冷|れい} (cold) + {蔵|ぞう} (to store). Most commonly encountered in the compound {冷蔵|れいぞう}{庫|こ} (refrigerator).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to refrigerate)
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}{庫|こ} (refrigerator)
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (refrigerated storage)
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (refrigerated truck)
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (cold room, walk-in cooler)
- ⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧{冷蔵|れいぞう} (requires refrigeration — label on food)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}: refrigeration (typically 0–10°C), for short-term freshness
- ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧: freezing (below 0°C), for long-term preservation
